item.title: A message from Mr. Warner.
item.description: Anyone interested in trying out for junior or senior girls' basketball should sign up in the gym foyer. The final Junior girls' tryout is today after school. Senior girls' tryouts are Wednesday September 9th and Friday September 11th after school. Please message Mr. Warner on Teams if you have any questions.

item.title: A message from Mr. Charlebois.
item.description: Anyone interested in running cross country this year, please meet in room 106 at 2:20.

item.title: A message from Mr. Curtis:
item.description: Music students interested in joining Yardbirds, meeting is today at 10:40 (beginning of lunch).

item.title: A Message from Mme Perron.
item.description: There will be a Europe Trip meeting today at lunch at 10:40 in room 125 please bring your lunch

item.title: A message from Mr. D'Alessio
item.description: Are you in Gr.9-12 and interested in joining the DRAMA CLUB? There will be a meeting Sept.30th. Stay tuned for more details.

item.title: A message from: Mr. Longval
item.description: Varsity Tackle Football Signups have started, come out and play for the Ravens. Please sign up outside Mr. Longval's office next to the gymnasium.

item.title: A message from Ms. Timmins
item.description: Attention all Grade 12 students with a spare or online course during Period 2: There will be a mandatory Grade 12 presentation today at 9:30 a.m. Please report to the atrium at that time. Following the presentation, please see Ms. Timmins or Mrs. Marcellus to pick up your information package.

item.title: A message from Mr. Danby.
item.description: A reminder to all boys in grades 9-12 who are trying out for the soccer team: you must return your signed participation form to play in Tuesday's scrimmage. If you missed yesterday's meeting, please see Mr. Danby in portable 315 during lunch today, or send him a message on Teams.

item.title: A message from Mr. Kwok:
item.description: Any high school girl who is interested in playing soccer this year is asked to sign up on a sheet in the gym foyer. Information about tryouts is on the sheet. Please reach out to Mr. Kwok if you have any questions

item.title: A message from Mr Kwok
item.description: There will be a meeting today at the beginning of lunch in portable 316 for any high school student interested in helping with the creation of this year's yearbook. If you cannot attend, please reach out to Mr. Kwok
